title: Western Line Dance Throwdown at Columbus
description:
Dust off your cowboy boots, grab your partner and get ready to scoot! Our Annual Senior Citizen Western Line Dance is just around the corner.

Join us for a boot scootin' good time filled with music, food, friends and fantastic dancing. This year, we are kicking things up a notch, so come dressed in your finest western attire. Best Boots Contest during the event, so make sure your footwear is shining and ready for the spotlight. Prize will be awarded to the top styles, unique and impressive boots in the room.

Whether you're a seasoned line dancer or just want to enjoy the great company, we want to see you there!


Participation in this event is reserved for Seniors from Central Region, Area 2 parks. In-person registration only. Please register in-person at any park located in Central Region, Area 2.

title: Hispanic Heritage Celebration at Humboldt
description:

title: We The People at Douglass
description:
Hearing in Color brings its resident vocal ensemble, Chroma, to the parks for We the People, a dynamic concert about belonging and justice. As part of the Chroma in the Parks series, this program features music by Chicago-based composers like Ayanna Woods and Jalen Scott, alongside selections inspired by artists like Beyoncé. Blending contemporary classical works, reimagined favorites, and new voices, we'll explore what it means to feel welcome - and how do we celebrate the many voices that shape our community.  Join us for an evening of powerful music, reflection, and joy in shared public spaces. chromachicago.org


  This event will be preceded by performances from the Ravinia Lawndale Family Music School Intermediate Violin students, taught by Rasa Mahmoudian, and the Adult Choir, taught by Allison Bystron, based at Homan Square Park. These ensembles are part of Ravinia's Reach Teach Play education program, which provides tuition-free music classes for children and adults in the Lawndale neighborhood. Interested Lawndale residents should email Haley Brown at hbrown@ravinia.org for more information.

title: Fiesta Mexicana: Interactive Family Show at Pasteur
description: What do a crawfish, a cowboy mouse, and a 100-year-old woman have in common? They are all characters in Fiesta Mexicana, Sones de Mexico Ensemble’s interactive family concert. This lively performance, perfect for all ages, takes audiences on a fun adventure with good music and stories. From the lush, tropical Huasteca region with a tale about “La Acamaya” to the festive finale with a folk version of “La Bamba” from Veracruz, enjoy a musical journey that celebrates Mexico’s diverse heritage. Bring the whole family and get ready to sing, clap, and dance along!

title: The Park After Dark at Chase
description:
Chase Park After Dark is an annual event to raise money for the Chase Park Teen Cub.  Every year, we transform the old theater into a brand-new haunted house, never repeating the same theme twice, creating a truly unique haunted experience.

Tickets are $16 and must be purchased in advance online. No children under the age of 13 will be permitted without parental advisory. This event is not recommended for anyone under the age of 10.

This event is sponsored by the Chase Park Advisory Council. For more information and to purchase tickets, please visit https://www.chaseparkafterdark.com/about
